title: Wall Street's worst week in 18 months: S&P 500 falls 8.6% and Nasdaq 10% as AI chip stocks crash
short: Wall Street's worst week in 18 months: S&P 500 −8.6%, Nasdaq −10%
dek: An AI and chip-stock selloff pushed the S&P 500 and Dow into a correction and wiped out the Nasdaq's 2026 gain, despite record Nvidia results. Bond yields fell, gold slid, and the Fed still looks set to hike.
card: The S&P 500 lost 8.6% and the Nasdaq 10% this week as Nvidia fell 14% in a day. What it means for India on Monday.
